newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-RECOBA FULFILS DESTINY BY JOINING INTERNAZIONALE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RECOBA FULFILS DESTINY BY JOINING INTERNAZIONALE.

text.p: Internazionale confirmed on Tuesday they had signed Uruguayan striker Alvaro Recoba from Nacional Montevideo for $4.1 million.
Recoba, who signed a four-year contract, said he had always known he would play for the serie A side one day.
"Inter were always part of my destiny," he said. "When I was 10 years old my dad gave me an Inter pendant as a present. I don't know why."
